reviews.title: I have used this app for more than 7 years!
reviews.text:
I love this app! I’ve been using it to journal for over 7 years. I love the little flashback memories/entries it shares with you! It’s awesome to be able to reflect back! 

I love how I can attach photos/videos and track how I’m feeling with each entry, too!

reviews.title: Fraudulent Charges
reviews.text: I used the app for a few months and thought it to be OK.  Several bugs with web use but it worked.  Nearly a year after canceling thru Apple I’m being charged again for cloud services. Their AI chat won’t get me to an actual person as I don’t have a bill.  All I have is a $30 charge from Journal.Cloud in Singapore which I will now have to dispute through VISA.  Beware!

reviews.title: DO NOT PURCHASE
reviews.text: I purchased this app many years ago, and used it sporadically for the first few. I then had an issue where I could not get into the app and repeatedly asked support for help. I never received any response. I decided I just wanted to cancel my subscription, but could not because I could not get into the app. I have asked them to cancel my subscription or to help me cancel my own subscription repeatedly over the past three to four years.  I have contacted them through their app, I have contacted them through their email, and in every way I could possibly find to contact them to cancel my account. I have never received a response. Today they charged me again. Today I will report them to my credit card company.

reviews.title: Best App Ever
reviews.text: I have been using this app to chronicle my life for the past eight years. Up to and including getting married, buying a house, raising my son, my wife being diagnosed with cancer, and eventually becoming a widow. Thank God for this app because I used to capture as much as possible and I can look back at my life now as if flipping through the pages of a novel. It also inspired me to create photo collages, home movies, and audio entries that add depth to my memories. Memories that are now perfectly preserved. Thanks Journey, from the bottom of my broken heart.

reviews.title: Beware!
reviews.text: Do NOT give this company your credit card number. I had a premium membership for the first year but downgraded to free tier. They still charged my card. I had to dispute it. A year later, they charged my card AGAIN, even though I’m on the free tier and never use their app. Both times I contacted customer support but they do not respond. I don’t think this company is even actively operating at this point.

reviews.title: Support for Moments?
reviews.text:
I have Lifetime Membership, but it took a full week to get a response. They said that they tried to respond to me before, but the problem is, there’s nothing to alert you that you’ve received a response. I’ve checked every single day, but when I eventually forget to keep checking, then they respond. 

My current case says that it’s still open, but the ability to respond is grayed out. They said that they fixed the help chat in this version, so I tried deleting the app and reinstalling it, but the help chat is still broken. 

Moments has stopped working. It still shows “moment” suggestions, but whenever I try to use one of them, it says “unsupported media” and only uses the moment title, and dumps all the rest of it.

In their help support, they sent me an article on what file types are supported, but these are the photos from the built-in Photos app on the iPhone, and what’s more, these are the Photos that were suggested by the built-in Moments feature in the Journey app. Also, I can go back and manually select the same photos it suggested. So, there’s nothing wrong with the media.

2026 update. Moments still doesn’t work. They have acknowledged this is known bug, and they are working on it, but it’s been several months now. This used to be one of the most useful features, which I used almost daily. It is now completely unusable, with no ETA of a fix.

reviews.title: Impossible to Cancel
reviews.text: Don’t bother. The native FREE Apple journal app basically does the same thing. The company has unethical business practices that make it nearly impossible to cancel your subscription. They confuse the user experience purposefully— if you “deactivate” your account, you are still charged bc technically, “you didn’t cancel”. If you subscribed via the website instead of the app, they will still charge you if you cancel the subscription via the App Store. And don’t even think about requesting a refund, you’ll be ignored.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
The Journey app, in general, seems like a great app for teens.  The design and number of creative options is definitely something that I think will make teens more apt to use it.

I was really excited about this app.  The reviews online stated there are 2 account options; a paid version, including all of the bells & whistles, and a ‘free’ version, which obviously includes some of the “fun” features but not all (which makes sense & I have no issue with).

I downloaded the app to see if my nieces would like it. INSERT DISAPPOINTMENT HERE!

The only “free version” I was able to find/see was the “free 3-day trial”.  THREE DAYS!!!! I admit, it’s better than nothing; it’s not a fair amount of time to really try the app out.
